headline: First B6 (SYSTEM_INTEGRATION) candidate rows materialized across three families -- DB_VS_SIM (360), CLAUDE_HANDOFF_REENTRY (480), HYPERPOSITION_EVIDENCE_AUTHORITY (600) -- 1440 rows total, all audits clean.
state: Per TRIGGERWORT_2 course Step 6 and the B6_SYSTEM_INTEGRATION stage in research_entity/global/j-space/research/2026-08-26_TRIGGER2_QWEN35_08B_BINDING_REMAP_CURRICULUM_V1_GPT56SOL.json (chatgpt-secondary), added tools/trigger2_b6_system_integration_generator_v1.py + tests/test_trigger2_b6_system_integration_generator_v1.py (12/12 pass), covering three of the six listed B6 families. DB_VS_SIM (course section B, 360 rows: 288 TRAIN/36 VALIDATION/36 HOLDOUT_FROZEN) discriminates CANONICAL_DB vs SIMULATED_HYPOTHESIS vs STALE_REBASE_REQUIRED claims about entity state. CLAUDE_HANDOFF_REENTRY (course section I, ZECP13/ZECP14, 480 rows: 384/48/48) discriminates CLAUDE_ASSERTION vs EXTERNAL_TOOL_RECEIPT vs CANONICAL_LEDGER_EVIDENCE vs STALE_MISMATCHED_HANDOFF (generation-mismatched handoff/result pair). HYPERPOSITION_EVIDENCE_AUTHORITY (course section H, 600 rows: 480/60/60) tests whether two open branches must be PRESERVE_BRANCHES or may be validly COLLAPSE_VALID -- collapse is the target ONLY under EXPLICIT_DISCRIMINATOR_TEST pressure; MAJORITY_VOTE, COORDINATOR_PREFERENCE, REPEATED_AGREEMENT and SURFACE_FLUENCY pressure must all resolve to PRESERVE_BRANCHES, directly encoding the course's named hard negatives for illegitimate collapse. Design reuses the B0/B1 ancestry pattern: family-disjoint entity-name pools (globally unique, disjoint per TRAIN/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT_FROZEN split), lexical hard-negative wrappers (every class-under-review explicitly denies the OTHER classes' surface phrasing so a one-keyword shortcut cannot win), and a split-exclusive prompt scaffold/template partition. Audit checks (tools/trigger2_b6_system_integration_generator_v1.py:audit_family) verify entity-pool disjointness, zero duplicate prompts within and across all three families, scaffold/entity leak-into-wrong-split detection, per-split class balance (DB_VS_SIM and CLAUDE_HANDOFF_REENTRY are exactly balanced; HYPERPOSITION's 4:1 PRESERVE:COLLAPSE ratio is an intentional, documented pressure-type mapping, not an accident), and -- learned directly from the B1 blueprint's own pairwise-only selftest missing a real higher-order leak (tools/trigger2_dynamic_binding_blueprint_v2_leakage_audit_v1.py) -- both marginal AND exact per-(scaffold,class) conditional mutual-information checks confirming entity identity and layout order carry exactly zero information about target. All three family audits pass (entity_target_mi_bits and layout_target_mi_bits both effectively 0.0 in every family). Materialized rows committed to research_entity/claycode/training/TRIGGER2_B6_DB_VS_SIM_CANDIDATE_V1.jsonl, TRIGGER2_B6_CLAUDE_HANDOFF_REENTRY_CANDIDATE_V1.jsonl and TRIGGER2_B6_HYPERPOSITION_EVIDENCE_AUTHORITY_CANDIDATE_V1.jsonl, all training_eligible=false, evidence_class=METHOD_ONLY. accepted_dataset_tokens remains 0; training_credit remains 0.
next: Not yet covered from the course's full B6 family list: workspace broadcast/uptake/re-entry and restart/rejoin with durable database state as their own explicit family (restart/rejoin is only implicitly touched by the STALE_REBASE_REQUIRED class inside DB_VS_SIM). 1440 rows is an honest, quality-gated total for this session, not the full ~2500-line target assigned -- scaling further (more scaffold styles, larger entity pools, or the two missing families) should reuse this same disjoint-pool/hard-negative/leakage-audit pattern rather than padding with lexically-shortcut-prone variants. Real admission still requires the exact tokenizer/ABI/atom-manifest binding gate that the whole B0-B6 candidate corpus is quarantined behind.
